title: Our New Referral Program: Earn Up to $1,000 in Credit for Every Company You Refer
body_markdown:
## **When your credit is earned**


Your company earns its reward when the company you referred completes its first transaction on Mobius and we receive payment in full, not when they sign up. They have six months from the date you submit the referral to complete that transaction. We issue your credit within 30 days after we receive payment.
‍


Credit expires 12 months after we issue it. Apply it toward purchases on Mobius. If you sell on Mobius, you can instead take the reward as a reduction to our fees on your next sale, as long as you tell us before that sale settles.


## **Who to refer**


Start with the manufacturers you know who hold excess or obsolete components: an OEM left with parts after a design change, or a contract manufacturer carrying stock from a canceled program. Those are the companies Mobius was built for.
‍


Referring a company that buys components earns the same rewards.
‍


The company you refer must be new to Mobius. That means it can't be a current or former customer, already in conversation with our team, or an affiliate of your company. If more than one company refers the same business, the first complete referral counts. There is no cap on how many companies you can refer.
‍


The referral program is separate from Invitations, which brings a buyer you know to a specific auction or listing. A referral introduces a company to Mobius as a whole.


## **How to refer a company**


Submit a referral on our referral page with your name, email, and company, plus the name, email, and company of your contact. Add a short note on how we could help them, then confirm that you are authorized to refer on behalf of your company and agree to the program terms.
‍


Our team takes it from there. We reach out to your contact directly and handle everything from the first conversation through the first transaction.


‍
